hook_text: Every business turns a month of chaos into three pages. Here is what each one secretly tells you.
clip_script: A repair shop at the end of March. Page one, the checklist: every ledger balance listed, debits on the left, credits on the right. One hundred and three thousand five hundred and fifty on each side. It balances, so the adding is right, but it does not prove there are no mistakes. Page two, the report card: the income statement. Money earned, eighteen thousand five hundred and fifty. Money used up, eight thousand three hundred and seventy. Profit: ten thousand one hundred and eighty rand for the month. Page three, the photograph: the balance sheet on the thirty-first of March. Owns ninety-two thousand one hundred and eighty. Belongs to the owner, sixty-seven thousand one hundred and eighty, and the bank, twenty-five thousand. The profit jumps from the report card into the photograph. That jump is the whole story of a good month.
visual_style: A whiteboard of three pages side by side: a two-column checklist with matching totals, a report card with a profit stamp, and a camera snapping a balance sheet with an arrow carrying the profit across.
mood: Clear and rewarding, like finishing a puzzle.
pacing: One beat per page, a slow arrow for the profit jump at the end.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and build all three pages yourself.
